cards: Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe
Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down
notes: Posted 7 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted in the first group (9): Set Your Course For Alderaan (posted 'SYCFA'), Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (posted 'DS DB'), Alderaan, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer, Start Your Engines! and Watto's Box; these count toward the 60.
The bare numbers 9, 5, 12, 2, 8 and 24 after each group are section counts; the draft read them as cards (including 'It Is The Future You See' and 'A Jedi's Strength') and they are dropped.

Posted 'DS DB' and 'Death Star DB x2' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), three copies in all; the strategy mentions pitching spare DBs to Visage. 'Alderaan', 'Tat Podrace arena' and 'boonta eve podrace' dested the Dark pages.

Posted 'SHUOSHD' dested Shut Him Up Or Shut Him Down (the strategy says it counters Bacta Tank); 'PASOA' Put All Sections On Alert; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'IG with gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Bossk in bus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckuss in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'U3PO' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio); 'CHYBC' Come Here You Big Coward.
Secret Plans, Come Here You Big Coward and No Escape are 2001 Effects, not Defensive Shields.
